title: Add “shaky handheld camera” to your Seedance prompt to introduce natural camera…
content:
Add “shaky handheld camera” to your Seedance prompt to introduce natural camera shake for more realistic footage  
Add “slight digital artifacts” to your Seedance prompt to mimic real camera/compression imperfections and avoid an overly clean look  
Add “small focus misses” (subtle focus hunting/soft focus moments) to your Seedance prompt to make the video feel more alive and realistic

es.content:

Añade "slight digital artifacts" a tu prompt de Seedance para imitar las imperfecciones reales de la cámara/compresión y evitar un aspecto demasiado limpio  
Añade "small focus misses" (momentos sutiles de búsqueda de enfoque/desenfoque suave) a tu prompt de Seedance para que el video se sienta más vivo y realista
